name: M3 Gratiot Pub
description: Gratiot Pub is a lively karaoke venue known for its vibrant open jam nights held three times a week. It features a welcoming atmosphere with talented musicians, a good sound system, and a diverse crowd that enjoys live music and karaoke. The venue offers a mix of public karaoke nights and open mic events, making it a popular spot for both casual singing and community gatherings. Its friendly staff and relaxed vibe create an inviting environment for all music lovers.
